Vault stays locked. Encrypted vault data is preserved; this error does not trigger deletion, a replacement vault, or a new device key.

Recovery-code password reset requires this installation’s working device key and intact installation and retry records. This build has no supported repair for a missing key or damaged records. A recovery code cannot bypass these checks. Recovery after uninstalling or moving to another device is not supported.

Biometrics are optional. Your password remains a separate unlock method. Enabling requires two separate biometric confirmations and leaves Vault locked. It cannot restore Vault after reinstalling, moving devices, or losing the device key. A recovery code also requires the original healthy installation and retry ledger.
